questions.text: Within the last year, have you been humiliated or emotionally abused in other ways by your partner or ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been afraid of your partner or ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been raped or forced to have any kind of sexual activity by your partner or ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been kicked, hit, slapped, or otherwise physically hurt by your partner or ex-partner?

title: HARK: Relationship Safety Questions
about: Four yes or no questions about a partner or ex-partner in the past year (Humiliation, Afraid, Rape, Kick). One point for each yes; 1 or more is a positive screen for intimate partner violence. Give it when the patient is alone, never with a partner present.
instructions: These questions are about a partner or ex-partner. Check Yes or No for each.

source.name: HARK, Sohal, Eldridge and Feder, BMC Family Practice 2007 (Table 1)

cutoffs.meaning: positive screen for intimate partner violence in the past year

cutoffs_source.citation: Sohal H, Eldridge S, Feder G. The sensitivity and specificity of four questions (HARK) to identify intimate partner violence: a diagnostic accuracy study in general practice. BMC Fam Pract. 2007;8:49.
cutoffs_source.stated: Table 1: "one point is given for every yes answer". At a score of 1 or more: sensitivity 81% (95% CI 69-90%), specificity 95% (91-98%), against the Composite Abuse Scale; 232 women in general practice in east London.

questions.1: Sohal 2007's Table 1, the published form, asks "by your partner or your ex-partner?"; LOINC 76500-8 has "by your partner or ex-partner?".
questions.4: Sohal 2007's Table 1 has "kicked, hit, slapped or otherwise physically hurt"; LOINC 76503-2 adds a comma before "or".
